feedback: The cold open works well with a sharp visual and a quick hook line. Tension ramps up nicely with the doppelganger and phone call motif. However, the dialogue and narrator style need minor tuning to match the requested 85-95% narration ratio. Ensure the emotional bond between Kabir and Sunny shines brighter in the middle cuts before the supernatural twist hits. REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: 2:45 baje, Tezpur hospital ki raat mein sab kuch thanda tha.
Kabir chhote bhai ke khilone ko sambhale, sapne mein uska chehra dekh raha.
Sunny hamesha mere saath khelta tha, ab uski awaaz sunke dil ruk jaata hai.
ICU ke andar phone par video call bajne laga.
ICU ke andher doctor Sunny ki body ko CPR de rahe the.
Bhaiya, doctor ne mana kiya hai, darwaza kholo...
Main hamesha tere saath rahunga, bhai.
Doctor ne phone nahi, ICU ko apna ghar bana liya hai.
Bhaiya, aaj bhi tumhe bula rahe hain.
Raat ko agar koi call aaye, toh darwaza mat kholna.
